flagged.title: Impact of the First World War on Germany
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states both on screen and in narration that Friedrich Ebert signed the armistice on 11 November 1918 rather than Matthias Erzberger, which will lose students marks in GCSE examinations.

mark_affecting.quote: Friedrich Ebert officially signed the armistice, ending the fighting

flagged.title: The Depression and the rise of the Nazis, 1928-1932
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states that May 1928 was 'just three months before' the October 1929 Wall Street Crash (a 14-month error distorting core GCSE chronology) and claims the KPD doubled its vote to 13.1%.

mark_affecting.quote: Back in May 1928, just three months before the catastrophic Wall Street crash...
the Communist Party, the KPD, also doubled their vote to 13.1%.
